newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand fair to moderate.
Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and no slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 6100 head confirmed, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - load Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lb Holsteins 61.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1250
